Thank you for your feedback. We apologize for the disappointment with your Spirit II E-210 grill. 

If the cooking grates aren't hot enough, food will stick, and you will likely never have a chance of searing properly or developing those amazing grill marks. Always preheat the grill on the highest setting first. Open the lid, turn up the heat, close the lid, and then let the cooking grate heat up for about ten minutes or until the lid thermometer reads 500° F (260° C).

We look forward to turning your experience around. Our Support team will be reaching out to assist you further. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText:
I've had a classic Weber Spirit 500 that I bought for $100 in a garage sale. It had only been used a couple of times. It lasted for more than 25 years. Had to replace the grates and flavorizer bars a couple of times along with the burner tubes once and a new ignitor about 5 years ago. Definitely got my money's worth, but it needed new burners and flavor bars again and two of the legs had rusted through, so it was time to replace it. 

The Spirit II E-210 seems to be the spiritual successor. The grilling area is almost identical and the the burners are laid out better to make temperature control easier. The overall construction seems more rugged and the electronic igniter is a plus. Bought it as a Father's Day gift to myself. 

It cooks great and looks great. I'll probably add the "i-Grill" accessory soon, but I'm 72 years old, so if this one lasts as long as the old one, it'll be the last gas grill I'll ever have to buy. Highly recommended.
Results.Title: A New Classic to Replace My Old Classic

Results.ReviewText: I had a Weber Silver Genesis A for 21 years. It was awesome. I choose the Spirit II E-210 to replace it. Big mistake. This thing flares up ALL the time. I can't walk away for a moment. It has ruined so much food. When reaching out to customer service, I ended up with 3 different people emailing me, then each telling me they'd close the ticket if I didn't respond in 7 days. NONE of them resolved the issue with the grill. I keep it cleaner than anyone. I'm a neat freak. I do everything I'm supposed to. This grill is just inferior. My friend bought the same one. Same story. As soon as any fat drips down, there's a flare-up. Wasn't Weber supposed to be the company to stop that from happening? It used to be. Do NOT buy this grill. Clearly, like everything else in this world, quality products are in the decline, customer service is lacking, and you end up disappointed. I will not be buying Weber again.
Results.Title: Nothing but flare-ups!

44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
